purpose: Historically usable replacement with conservative regional transfer and explicit uncertainty
neural_fit: Frozen v7 architecture, fine features, 160 epochs, seeds42/43/44. All preprocessing/count scales/quantile knots are fitted on each fold training data only. No boosted teacher.
mixing: Separate north/south latitude39.5 controls, chosen from training-period OOF predictions only. Convex blends of baseline with either learned expert at weights0,.1,.25,.5,.75,1. Backward fold mean MAE receives70% weight, forward30%. Eligible blends must not worsen any regional fold monthly MAE or cell MAE more than5%; require at least5% weighted score gain, otherwise use baseline.
promotion: Require >=5% statewide monthly MAE improvement on both forward periods and2012 statewide; each north/south monthly MAE and overall cell MAE no more than5% worse than actual deployed baseline in every period. Do not tune weights against audit years. If no candidate passes, do not promote it. Further experiments remain separate and disclosed.
history_policy: Before Aqua operation July2002, fall back to deployed count calibration and mark the sampling-regime extrapolation. Missing source months remain null; observed SNPP values fromFebruary2012 remain observed, not replaced with predictions.
uncertainty: Empirical region/month residual bands on2021-2022 after freezing OOF selection, assessed on2023-2025 and2012; year-block bootstrap training-data variability separately. No confidence guarantee before2012 or under historical shift. All research periods were previously inspected; disclose repeated development.
production: Only integrate a verified passing candidate. Back up exact original prepared payload/estimator, preserve observations/extremes/outage metadata, retain baseline comparison and reproducible restoration. No publication or deployment.
